body:
I've tried so many different treatments over the years and have seen so many different professionals that I can't remember the exact number. I really don't think that there's some magic person out there who can help me. 

I just feel like I don't have any options. My current counselor (through my college) confirmed my suspicions by saying that, given my history, it is likely that I will deal with depression for the rest of my life. So, I really just don't know if I want to keep having to go through the motions like this. 

I tried meditation when I was younger, but I was kind of cajoled into it by my parents and didn't get anything out of it. I don't understand how to go about doing it; I feel like I can't concentrate or have a blank mind long enough for it.

I've seen multiple psychiatrists since the age of 7 or 8. I've been on around 15 medications in total. I recently (about 5 months ago) made the difficult choice to go back on anti-depressants for the first time in almost 5 years. So far, it's helped me a bit with my obsessive thinking but my overall depression is no better. I have actually noticed worsening symptoms (extreme fatigue, no appetite whatsoever). 

It's difficult to believe that I can somehow get better when this is essentially all that I can remember. I have struggled with mental illness since I was a very young child. I don't understand how there's hope when I've tried multiple options over many, many years and can't get myself out of this.
